learning_outcomes.text: Acquire the ability to identify the basic technologies and technical aspects of internal combustion and reciprocating engines.
Acquire the ability to perform simple and complex calculations to evaluate the operation of internal combustion and reciprocating engines.
Acquire the ability to disassemble and recognize the basic parts of an internal combustion and reciprocating engine.
Acquire the ability to evaluate the condition of a thermal engine from its data.
Acquire the ability to select the correct thermal engine for a specific use from several options.
Acquire the ability to determine the potential uses of a thermal engine from its data.
Acquire the ability to give a public presentation on a topic related to thermal engines.

syllabus_topics: CONSTRUCTIVE ELEMENTS OF RECIPROCATING INTERNAL COMBUSTION ENGINES (RICES)
COMBUSTION IN COMPRESSION IGNITION ENGINES. DIESEL ENGINES

assessment_methods.method: Attendance to practical sessions and submission of reports
Presentation of a topic chosen by the student

assessment_rules: Students can choose between two evaluation options: continuous evaluation or evaluation by exam. For continuous evaluation, attendance and practical reports account for 20%, submitted problems 20%, a student presentation 20%, and online questionnaires 40%. For evaluation by exam, a single exam consisting of 40 multiple-choice questions and two problems constitutes 100% of the grade. The course is passed when a grade of 5 is obtained in either option. Students choosing the exam option must notify the professor by email 10 days before the exam date. Incorrect answers in tests and problems do not penalize.
